# Native runtime metadata controls for SDK 0.9.12

All CF/XML pairs were saved by platform 8.3.27.2342 from owned measurement configurations. Runtime receipts were produced by real platform metadata getters; the SDK did not generate oracle answers. `provenance.json` records byte hashes and the public CF-container extraction tool commit. Raw DEFLATE resources and inflated `.config` files were extracted from the independent CF.

`resources.txt` selects relevant metadata owner/root resources. Unrelated modules, languages and form copies are omitted; full CF and Configuration.xml still preserve the complete independent configuration. `measure.bsl` preserves the executed probe where additional measurements were needed. `content-oracle.tsv` maps native runtime FullName values through independent exported XML to GUIDs, retaining native iteration order and conditional identities.

Controls:

- native/catalog-native/register-native: sources, explicit flags, complete 0/1/2 parameter membership.
- common-disabled/common-separate: independent separation mode versus settings presence.
- condition/order/order-reversed: Boolean-constant conditional identity; GUID order independent of explicit Items.
- separate/disabled: all ordinary persistent classes; exclusions for Enum, Report, DataProcessor and Numerator.
- settings: catalog ForItem/ForFolder/ForFolderAndItem, information-register independent/recorder-subordinate and nonperiodical/day profiles, two Use links of one parameter, explicit Auto.
- scheduled-separate/scheduled-disabled: disabled scheduled-job metadata included only in Separate, no job execution.
- inapplicable: source `input.xml` contains Constant.Use in DontUse; platform removes that Item before independent CF/XML export. Runtime excludes the constant.

All new infobases were disposable `/tmp` controls. No production or demo database was changed by measurements.
